data.long_meaning: Prakash is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘prakasha’, which means ‘light’ or ‘radiance’. In Hindu mythology, Prakash is a name given to the god Vishnu, who is believed to dispel darkness and ignorance. The name is also given to the Sun god, who is the source of light and energy. Prakash is a symbol of enlightenment, knowledge, and wisdom.

In Hindu festivals, the name Prakash is given to the deity, symbolizing his manifestation as the source of light and knowledge. Additionally, light and diyas (oil lamps) are an essential part of Hindu rituals and celebrations, reflecting the importance of light in Hinduism.
